heading: 6.1 Grouped scalars (interconvertible)
text:
### 6.1 Grouped scalars (interconvertible) [LUNI.6.1]

Units within the same scalar group are interconvertible via affine conversion
(offset only — all dB variants of the same reference type differ by a constant).

The affine expression gives the stored base value: `= x + c` means `base = declared + c`.
